name: summrise-agent
description: Summrise Agent — Windows device MCP server (terminal/SSH/serial) + panel. Self-hosted npm distribution.
//build: 唯一构建路径：在本目录执行 npm run build。它是自包含的：经 npm exec 按需拉取 typescript@5，无需预装任何 node_modules（干净检出可跑；旧脚本引用 ../summrise-desktop-electron/node_modules/.bin/tsc，干净检出必 ENOENT）。必须用 npm exec --package … -- tsc 的形式：npx 会吃掉传给 tsc 的 -p/--outDir 等参数（round-435：npx 写法从未真正跑通过）。 LANDING 4b: the CLI IS A RUST BINARY NOW (bin/summrise.exe, built by `cargo xwin build -p summrise-cli` and staged by scripts/build.sh) — nothing here compiles it, and src/summrise.ts + bin/summrise.js are DELETED. This script therefore only compiles the electron TS (--noCheck pure emit, same as release.yml) and syncs both src/*.js copies. LANDING 6: the desktop shell's URL/certificate policy is Rust compiled to wasm. summrise_url_policy.js and summrise_url_policy_bg.wasm are NOT built here — agent/summrise-url-policy/build.sh produces them (wasm-pack) and they are committed — this script only COPIES the committed pair into the package's own summrise-desktop-electron/src/, the way it does for main.js/preload.js, so that npm pack carries what the shell requires.

scripts.build: npm exec --yes --package typescript@5.9.3 -- tsc -p ../summrise-desktop-electron/tsconfig.json --outDir /tmp/summrise-electron-fresh --noCheck && cp /tmp/summrise-electron-fresh/main.js ../summrise-desktop-electron/src/main.js && cp /tmp/summrise-electron-fresh/preload.js ../summrise-desktop-electron/src/preload.js && cp ../summrise-desktop-electron/src/main.js ../summrise-desktop-electron/src/preload.js ../summrise-desktop-electron/src/summrise_url_policy.js ../summrise-desktop-electron/src/summrise_url_policy_bg.wasm ../summrise-desktop-electron/src/summrise_shell_policy.js ../summrise-desktop-electron/src/summrise_shell_policy_bg.wasm ./summrise-desktop-electron/src/ && rm -rf /tmp/summrise-electron-fresh
